nina: FYI Meridian Dataworks invoice INV-26-3098 is blocked. System flagged a PO renumber + bank change in the same submission. :thinking_face:

owen: Can someone paste the PO printed on the PDF so I can try an auto-match?

nina: Invoice PO = MDW-1900-OLD. Our canonical PO for them is MDW-2600-AFT (post-acquisition renumber).

carla: Quick context from vendor: Meridian was acquired and their AP team accidentally used the legacy PO format on the reissued invoice. They say the canonical PO is MDW-2600-AFT. They also changed the receiving entity for payments, so bank details changed.

```
legacy_account: MERID-OLD-81
new_account: MERID-PAY-900 (effective 2026-04-02)
```

samir: Any bank update triggers KBA/KYC verification and procurement review for supplier legal entity changes. Were short-staffed today and Im on a delayed response.

approvals-bot: Hold created: reasons=[PO_RENUMBER, BANK_UPDATE_UNVERIFIED]; actions_required=[attach_po_amendment, vendor_bank_proof, procurement_entity_confirm_or_finance_2up].

owen: Two distinct risk controls here. If vendor uploads an amendment that explicitly maps MDW-1900-OLD -> MDW-2600-AFT and includes tax ID, Finance can do a temporary 2-up signoff to avoid late fees. Otherwise we wait for procurement verification.

carla: Uploading signed amendment and bank proof now. Link: https://files.meridian.example/INV-26-3098-amend.pdf. Amendment references both PO numbers and includes vendor EIN.

nina: Please include a short audit note with GL and cost center so Billing can request Treasury manual override if needed. This invoice is cloud infra consumption for April.

owen: Agreed. Post GL and cost center and Ill queue the manual override request. Need two approvers.

nina: GL=5409-infra; cost_center=compute-ops-prod. Audit note: "Temporary finance approval contingent on procurement reconfirmation; vendor amendment and bank proof attached."

approvals-bot: Documents attached. Pending actions: [procurement_ticket_when_available, treasury_manual_override_request].

owen: I submitted the manual override to Treasury: ref "Meridian acquisition renumber - temporary 2-up finance signoff; docs attached." Treasury ETA 24-48h; flagged urgent due to vendor late fee policy.

samir: I will open a procurement ticket to reconcile the supplier entity mapping once back online and set priority high. If procurement finds mismatch, we will retroactively correct PO records and document the rationale.

carla: Vendor requests confirmation once payment is initiated. They said this cashflow timing is critical.

nina: Noted. Ill monitor and update thread when Treasury confirms inclusion. If Treasury declines manual override we escalate to Finance Manager for emergency signoff.

owen: Closing summary: vendor amendment + bank proof uploaded; GL set; manual override requested; approvals-bot hold remains until procurement reconciles or Treasury approves.

carla: Thank you all  appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor acquisition caused PO renumber + bank change; includes root message and replies in chronological order
